rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The PT's II Congresso Nacional was held from 24 to 28 November [1999] at the Sesc Venda Nova, Belo Horizonte, with 928 delegates; its agenda included the renewal of the national leadership and of the presidency, and three 'presidenciáveis' were known in advance: José Dirceu (seeking a third term), Milton Temer and Arlindo Chinaglia.

locator.item: lead article 'PT realiza seu II Congresso ...'

rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: Before 17:00 on Sunday 28 November the result of the election for party president was known: José Dirceu was re-elected with 496 votes, Milton Temer 296, Arlindo Chinaglia 113, with five null and four blank; the Congresso closed after the results were announced.
